info.title: cl-router API
info.description: Primitive-routed inference API. Provider credentials belong exclusively to the router deployment. Runtime validation additionally enforces relational limits and asset host policy.

503.description: Router unavailable, candidates exhausted, or execution budget exhausted. Inspect error.code, retryable, and executionStarted; HTTP status alone does not determine retry safety.

post.description: Convex durable lane. Returns 202 after idempotent metadata submission; input and result remain consumer-owned. No provider replay on worker loss.

provider.description: Browser backend; defaults to sandbox. Browserbase is the backup.

mode.description: Defaults to password, which requires password. Passwordless must omit password.

contact.description: Caller authorization for one contact submission. Mutually exclusive with signup; use a separate job.

fallbackToBrowserbase.description: Defaults to true. Fall back when the sandbox is unavailable or encounters an initial bot wall, only before agent actions.

skills.description: Skills to offer the agent. Omit for the operation's defaults; an empty array disables skills.

features.description: Optional request features this deployment accepts: `inline_job_input`, `prompt_cache_key`, `agent_loop`, `parallel_tool_calls`, `requirements_quality`. Check before sending them; older deployments reject unknown fields.

promptCacheKey.description: Honors `cache.key` as a provider prompt-cache key.

benchmarks.description: Published scores that rank routed generation, in hundredths of a percentage point. `inherited` copies the card row of the model's nearest scored ancestor in the same product line.

ci.description: Published 95% CI half-width in hundredths; null when the source publishes none.

routedGeneration.description: Whether routed generation may select this model: it has a benchmark score, is not cost-excluded and is not pending a capability measurement. /v1/manual can call every model.

EmbedRequest.description: The product of texts.length and dimensions (default 1536) must not exceed 200000. Chunk larger batches before sending them.

source.description: `loop` means `loop.previous` was reused without a Jev call; it is returned only to callers that send `loop`.

quality.description: Routing cost posture over the benchmark-ranked candidates: `high` ranks on benchmark score alone and ignores Jev's easy ratings, `economy` ranks on price alone, `balanced` (the default) trades one benchmark point per doubling of price and lets a conclusive easy rating from Jev cheapen it. Never relaxes capabilities or eligibility. Ignored by /v1/manual.

providerMetadata.description: Opaque provider continuation data (for example reasoning signatures or encrypted reasoning). Send it back unchanged on the same part.

provider.description: Provider that produced the reasoning. Other providers never receive it.

providerMetadata.description: Opaque provider continuation data (for example reasoning signatures or encrypted reasoning). Send it back unchanged on the same part.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for models that support it; omitted uses the provider default. Ignored by providers without an effort control.

include.description: Return reasoning (`reasoning-delta`/`reasoning-end` stream events, or `message` on JSON responses) and provider continuation metadata so the next turn can send it back.

toolSelection.description: Who selects among the supplied tools. `router` (default) lets the router decide whether and which tools run; `caller` skips router tool selection: every supplied tool stays available with automatic tool choice. Ignored with `loop`, which always leaves the choice to the model.

parallelToolCalls.description: Allow (true) or forbid (false) several tool calls in one step on models with a documented control (see `/v1/capabilities`); omitted keeps the provider default. Ignored elsewhere.

key.description: Stable key for requests that share a prompt prefix (for example one agent run). Hashed with the tenant before it reaches a provider; never stored.

previous.description: The previous step's response `routing.route` and `routing.difficulty`. Reused without a Jev call only when the last message is a tool result; ignored by /v1/manual.

loop.description: Marks one step of an agent loop: the router asks no tool questions and never restricts or forces tool choice, so the provider tools array stays identical across steps.

DecisionAsset.description: A PNG or JPEG (280-1568 px per side) keyed by a reference string that must appear in the state, instructions, or criteria. Inline base64 or a consumer-owned asset reference that the router fetches. Up to 8 assets, 12 MiB each, 16 MiB total; JSON requests are limited to 4 MiB, so use `source` for larger images. Requires Jev 1.13+; sets TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Images automatically.

model.description: Model that served this decision: the concrete TypeSafe Jev version (e.g. "jev-1.14.0"; requests use jev-latest or TYPESAFE_MODEL), or "clef" when Jev was unavailable and Cloudflare's Clef answered instead.
